{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer in charcoal grey with a relaxed fit, crafted from heavy wool-blend fabric for durability against the rain.
Tailored trousers in matching charcoal wool with a slight crease down the front, featuring an ankle-length hem to prevent dragging in wet conditions.
A crisp white silk blouse tucked neatly underneath, adding a professional layer without bulk.
Suede ankle boots in dark brown with a low, non-slip heel and water-resistant treatment, fulfilling her specific wish for comfortable walking footwear.

This outfit works perfectly for a rainy workday on foot because the structured outer layers shield against autumn drizzle while the wool blends retain warmth during long walks. The dark color palette ensures she remains unblemished by splashes, and the ankle-length trouser hems prevent fabric from becoming heavy with water. By prioritizing suede ankle boots as requested, the ensemble guarantees stability and comfort without sacrificing a polished business look appropriate for an office setting."}
